deepseek_v4_pro/001: The strategy for this policy uses iterative deepening negamax search with alpha-beta pruning on a bitboard representation. The heuristic evaluation function computes the mobility difference (number of legal moves for the current player minus the opponent’s legal moves). Moves are ordered by this heuristic to improve pruning efficiency. When time is close to the 1-second limit, the search is aborted and the best move from the deepest completed iteration is returned.
deepseek_v4_pro/002: The strategy for this policy uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with random playouts. The board is converted to efficient bitboard representations, and all legal moves are precomputed. During the allowed time (~0.9 seconds), the algorithm iteratively selects, expands, simulates, and backpropagates to build a search tree. The final move is chosen based on the child with the highest visit count, providing a robust and competitive policy without requiring handcrafted heuristics.
deepseek_v4_pro/003: The strategy for this policy is to use iterative deepening alpha-beta search with a heuristic evaluation function. The evaluation prioritizes mobility (number of legal moves available to each player) and includes a small piece-count bonus. Moves are ordered by the number of opponent moves after the move, which improves pruning. The search runs until nearly 1 second has elapsed and returns the best move found from the deepest completed search.
deepseek_v4_pro/004:
The strategy for this policy is a minimax search with alpha‑beta pruning, combined with iterative deepening to make full use of the 1‑second time limit.  
The leaf evaluation is based on **mobility**: the number of legal moves available to the player to move minus the number of legal moves available to the opponent. This captures the essential goal of Clobber – leaving the opponent without moves.  
Moves are ordered at each node by performing a one‑ply shallow evaluation (negamax score after the move) to improve pruning efficiency.  
The search starts at depth 1 and increases depth until time runs out; it always returns the best move found in the deepest fully completed iteration, guaranteeing a legal move.
deepseek_v4_pro/005: The strategy for this policy is to use an iterative deepening alpha-beta search with a combined material and mobility heuristic. The algorithm explores the game tree, evaluating positions based on the difference in number of pieces and the number of legal moves available to each player (with a small weight for mobility). The search depth is increased incrementally until 0.9 seconds have elapsed, at which point the best move found from the deepest completed search is returned. Move ordering is performed at every node by sorting child positions according to the heuristic, which significantly improves the efficiency of alpha-beta pruning and allows the search to reach greater depths within the time limit.
